gate.details:
All three gates pass.

Results:
1. Key parity: de, en, es and fr all parse and each has the same 396 flattened keys, with none missing or extra. Arrays were compared as single leaf values, so array contents were not checked.
2. i18n:scan: 56 Missing Keys rows, equal to the baseline. That is the same count of 14 per locale across de, en, es and fr, in QuoteSection.vue, IconsInfo.vue, EmailObfuscator.vue and HeroTitle.vue. All 56 are call-site issues in components, not gaps in any locale file, and none come from fr.json. `HERO_HEADING_KEYS.line1` looks like a scanner false positive on a variable reference. The 56 baseline was taken from the task; I did not re-measure it against the pre-change tree.
3. Unit tests: exit 0, 44 files and 1519 tests passed.

For the reviewer:
- The only uncommitted change is one line in src/i18n/ui/fr.json (line 381, `web.homepage.hero.title.line1` by its position in the diff). It replaces the ` ` escape with a literal U+00A0 byte (c2 a0, confirmed with xxd). The parsed value is identical, so this has no effect on the UI. It looks like a re-serialization artifact, not a translation edit. It was already present at the start of this gate, so the gate did not cause it.
- That literal U+00A0 is the only NBSP in fr.json, and it is invisible in most editors and diffs. Other French strings use a plain space before `?` and `:`, for example lines 110, 263 and 493. Either restoring the escape or dropping this line from the commit would keep the diff clean. A separate question is whether French punctuation should use NBSP throughout, because plain spaces can wrap the `?` onto its own line.
- Committed on this branch (c5d6876f, not uncommitted): "IT & DevOps" became "Informatique et DevOps", and the nav label "Changelog" became "Journal des modifications". The nav label matches `changelog.label` on line 532. The longer string may need a visual check in the nav or footer layout, because the gate does not test rendering.
- These gates do not assess translation quality. pnpm type-check, lint and check were not part of this gate and were not run.

No tracked files were modified by this gate. The helper script and logs are in <local scratch> (keys.cjs, scan.log, test.log).
